timing: New observer, checker and rules are committed before either full observation. These are post-incident executions, not newly discovered outputs from the old study or old hosted run.

cases.selection: All fixed combinations in their declared roster; no results-based case or environment selection

scope: Each new observation machine decodes both fixed archived input populations. These are neither actions historically executed on both machines nor complete closed-loop trajectory comparisons.
invariants: All frozen 45/46/48/51/52/54 implementations, original source manifests, tolerances and primary/supplemental outputs remain unchanged
No model training, new objective evaluation, policy optimization, calibration refit, threshold selection or ISA search
Original strict 54 failure remains a failure; 57/58 have a separate recorded-observation obligation
Preserve raw logs, actual nonlinear outputs, T/q, complete sets, flags and all unsuccessful observations

execution.CPU_mode: Default observed execution environment; record CPU, libraries and thread settings, never search alternatives
execution.source_freeze: Validate source and protocol against committed blobs before capture and verify source/input identities again afterward
execution.byte_identity: Record observed byte hashes separately from normalized text identities; never substitute current checkout bytes for historical observed metadata

acceptance_obligations: Exactly one complete observation per fixed label, with every case and state in roster order
Independent conditional Decimal softmax and full expectation/variance/clip step envelopes for recorded outputs, with explicit arithmetic assumptions
Strict original CP identity, finite normalized probabilities, order statistic, rank, kth identity, complete sets and monitor flags
Differences and displayed summaries reconstructed from verified recorded arrays using basic IEEE subtraction, comparison and maxima; no current-backend nonlinear recomputation as historical identity
Original strict 54 exit status, full log and actual comparison retained; accept only the identified comparison assertion as an expected strict failure, reject all other child errors
Probability, finite step, T/q, set, flags, roster, input and summary mutations rejected by substantive mathematical or structural checks
excluded_claims: Bitwise backend identity, future numerical-backend agreement or full trajectory equivalence
New independent policy evidence, clinical or hardware validation, or changed primary negative_stop
failure_action: Preserve failed observations and logs. Do not change runtime modes, policy, thresholds, data or numerical acceptance bounds to obtain a pass.
